Your Attack level is used to determine how likely you are to hit your target in melee combat. A higher Attack level will give you a better chance to hit.
translation: Saldiri seviyeniz, yakin dövüste hedefinizi vurma olasiliginizi belirlemek icin kullanilir. Daha yüksek bir Saldiri seviyesi, vurma sansinizi artirir.

english: Additionally, a higher Attack level will allow you to wield more powerful weapons. A weapon with a higher Attack bonus will give you more accuracy in combat.
translation: Ayrica, daha yüksek bir Saldiri seviyesi, daha güclü silahlar kullanmaniza olanak tanir. Daha yüksek Saldiri bonusu olan bir silah, savasta daha fazla isabet orani saglar.

english: You can select your Attack style from the Combat Options side panel. Different enemies are weaker or stronger against different Attack styles, so choose carefully.
translation: Saldiri stilinizi Savas Secenekleri yan panelinden secebilirsiniz. Farkli düsmanlar, farkli Saldiri stillerine karsi daha zayif veya daha güclüdür, bu yüzden dikkatli secin.

english: As with any skill, you will restore <Num0> missing Hitpoint every minute, but the best way of recovering Hitpoints is by eating food.
translation: Diger becerilerde oldugu gibi, her dakika <Num0> eksik Can Puani geri kazanirsiniz, ancak Can Puani geri kazanmanin en iyi yolu yemek yemektir.

english: Mining allows you to get various minerals from the world, for use in other skills; primarily Smithing.
translation: Madencilik, diger becerilerde, özellikle de Demircilik'te kullanmak üzere dünyadan cesitli mineraller elde etmenizi saglar.

english: To mine a rock, simply interact with it while holding a pickaxe you have the level to use and you'll start mining it. Eventually, you'll collect the ore and the rock will deplete. Low level rocks will replenish themselves fairly quickly, but higher level ones will take longer and longer to come back.
translation: Bir kayayi madencilige acmak icin, kullanabileceginiz seviyede bir kazma tutarken onunla etkilesime gecmeniz yeterlidir. Sonunda cevheri toplarsiniz ve kaya tükenir. Düsük seviyeli kayalar oldukca hizli bir sekilde yenilenir, ancak daha yüksek seviyeli kayalarin geri gelmesi daha uzun sürer.

english: At higher mining levels, you'll have an increased chance of successfully mining a rock. You'll also be able to use more powerful pickaxes, which decrease the amount of time between mining attempts.
translation: Daha yüksek madencilik seviyelerinde, bir kayayi basarili bir sekilde madenciligi yapma sansiniz artar. Ayrica, madencilik denemeleri arasindaki süreyi azaltan daha güclü kazmalar kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Note that while most pickaxes have an Attack level requirement to equip them, you're still able to use them from within your inventory if you have the required Mining level.
translation: cogu kazmanin donatilmasi icin Saldiri seviyesi gereksinimi olsa da, gerekli Madencilik seviyesine sahipseniz bunlari envanterinizden kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Your Strength level determines your max hit in combat. Whenever you hit your opponent, you will deal a random amount of damage up to your max hit.
translation: Güc seviyeniz, savasta maksimum vurusunuzu belirler. Rakibinize vurdugunuzda, maksimum vurusunuza kadar rastgele bir miktar hasar verirsiniz.

english: Most weapons have a Strength bonus that will also increase your max hit. You can view your Strength bonus (and all of your equipment's stats) by selecting 'View equipment stats' under the Worn Equipment side panel.
translation: cogu silah, maksimum vurusunuzu da artiran bir Güc bonusu icerir. Güc bonusunuzu (ve tüm ekipmaninizin istatistiklerini) Takili Ekipman yan panelinden “Ekipman istatistiklerini görüntüle” secenegini secerek görüntüleyebilirsiniz.

english: Agility both increases the rate at which your Run Energy replenishes while not running and decreases the rate at which it drains while you run.
translation: ceviklik, kosmadiginiz sirada Kosma Enerjinizin yenilenme hizini artirirken, kostugunuz sirada bu enerjinin tükenme hizini azaltir.

english: You will also gain access to useful shortcuts across Gielinor; these are marked with a green arrow on your map.
translation: Ayrica Gielinor'da kullanisli kisayollara erisim kazanirsiniz; bunlar haritanizda yesil oklarla isaretlenmistir.

english: In order to train your Agility skill, you will need an Agility course; these are a series of obstacles that reward experience upon completion.
translation: ceviklik becerinizi gelistirmek icin bir ceviklik parkuruna ihtiyaciniz olacak; bu parkurlar, tamamlandiginda deneyim puani kazandiran bir dizi engelden olusur.

english: Smithing lets you convert raw ores into useful metals, then use those metals to make your own weapons and armour.
translation: Demircilik, ham cevherleri kullanisli metallere dönüstürmenizi ve bu metalleri kendi silah ve zirhlarinizi yapmak icin kullanmanizi saglar.

english: To smelt ores, simply take the mix of ores you need to any furnace and you'll be able to convert them into bars.
translation: Cevherleri eritmek icin, ihtiyaciniz olan cevher karisimini herhangi bir firina götürün ve bunlari külcelere dönüstürebilirsiniz.

english: Once you have your bars, grab a hammer and take them to an anvil. Bigger items will need more bars to make.
translation: cubuklarinizi aldiktan sonra, bir cekic alin ve bunlari bir örsün üzerine koyun. Daha büyük esyalar yapmak icin daha fazla cubuk gerekir.

english: As you advance your Smithing level, you'll be able to make make more gear out of higher quality metals.
translation: Demircilik seviyenizi yükseltirken, daha yüksek kaliteli metallerden daha fazla ekipman yapabileceksiniz.

english: Your Defence level determines how likely you are to block enemy attacks. The chances of this happening increase with your level, but be careful; you are never guaranteed to block every attack!
translation: Savunma seviyeniz, düsman saldirilarini engelleme olasiliginizi belirler. Bu olasilik seviyeniz yükseldikce artar, ancak dikkatli olun; her saldiriyi engelleyeceginiz garanti degildir!

english: Additionally, a higher Defence level will allow you to equip more powerful shields and armour. As well as giving you better defensive stats, some armour will also increase your Attack or Strength bonuses as well.
translation: Ayrica, daha yüksek bir Savunma seviyesi, daha güclü kalkanlar ve zirhlar giymenizi saglar. Bazi zirhlar size daha iyi savunma istatistikleri saglamanin yani sira, Saldiri veya Güc bonuslarinizi da artirir.

english: Herblore allows you to make potions with herbs and ingredients found across Gielinor.
translation: Herblore, Gielinor'da bulunan otlar ve malzemelerle iksir yapmanizi saglar.

english: To make a potion, you first need to clean a grimy herb, then combine it with a vial of water to make an unfinished potion. You can then add the secondary ingredient(s) to complete the potion.
translation: Bir iksir yapmak icin önce kirli otlari temizlemeniz, ardindan bir sise suyla birlestirerek bitmemis bir iksir yapmaniz gerekir. Daha sonra ikincil malzemeyi/malzemeleri ekleyerek iksiri tamamlayabilirsiniz.

english: Fishing allows you to gather fish at various points across Gielinor. Typically, these will be indicated by moving bubbles on the surface of the water.
translation: Fishing, Gielinor'un cesitli noktalarinda balik avlamaniza olanak tanir. Genellikle, bunlar su yüzeyinde hareket eden kabarciklarla gösterilir.

english: Different fish require different equipment to catch; for instance, you need a fishing net to catch shrimp, but a fishing rod and bait to catch sardines.
translation: Farkli baliklar, farkli ekipmanlarla avlanir; örnegin, karides avlamak icin balik agina, sardalya avlamak icin ise olta ve yem gerekir.

english: As your Fishing level increases, you'll gain access to more varieties of fish to catch, as well as having a higher chance of successfully catching fish when you try.
translation: Balikcilik seviyeniz arttikca, yakalayabileceginiz balik cesitleri artar ve balik yakalama sansiniz da yükselir.

english: Your Ranged level determines how accurate you are with ranged weapons, as well as how much damage they do. A higher Ranged level will result in more hits that do more damage.
translation: Menzilli seviyeniz, menzilli silahlarla ne kadar isabetli oldugunuzu ve bu silahlarin ne kadar hasar verdigini belirler. Menzilli seviyeniz ne kadar yüksekse, daha fazla hasar veren vuruslar yaparsiniz.

english: Most ranged weapons will need a specific kind of ammunition to go with them; for instance, bows will need arrows and crossbows will need bolts.
translation: cogu menzilli silahin kendine özgü bir mühimmat türüne ihtiyaci vardir; örnegin, yaylar ok, tatar yaylari ise ok uclarina ihtiyac duyar.

english: As your Ranged level increases, you will also get access to more powerful weapons and ammunition. Typically, each ranged weapon can only handle ammo up to a certain level; for instance, an oak bow can only fire bronze, iron or steel arrows, but not mithril.
translation: Menzilli seviyeniz arttikca, daha güclü silahlara ve mühimmatlara erisim kazanirsiniz. Genellikle, her menzilli silah belirli bir seviyeye kadar mühimmat kullanabilir; örnegin, mese yay sadece bronz, demir veya celik oklari atesleyebilir, ancak mithril oklari atesleyemez.

english: Thieving lets you steal items from various people and stalls. Be careful, as people won't take too kindly to you going through their pockets, and might call the guards on you, or may take matters into their own hands.
translation: Hirsizlik, cesitli kisilerden ve tezgahlardan esya calmaniza olanak tanir. Dikkatli olun, cünkü insanlar ceplerini karistirmaniza pek hos bakmayabilir ve sizi muhafizlara sikayet edebilir veya kendi baslarina harekete gecebilirler.

english: As your Thieving level increases, the odds of you successfully stealing from your target will increase. You will also gain access to more lucrative targets with more valuable loot.
translation: Hirsizlik seviyeniz arttikca, hedefinizden basarili bir sekilde calma olasiliginiz da artar. Ayrica, daha degerli ganimetler iceren daha kazancli hedeflere erisim elde edersiniz.

english: Cooking is a skill that lets you make all kinds of delicious food that will typically restore your Hitpoints, amongst providing other benefits.
translation: Ascilik, genellikle Can Puaninizi geri kazandiran ve diger faydalar saglayan her türlü lezzetli yemegi yapmanizi saglayan bir beceridir.

english: At its most basic, Cooking can be done by simply taking raw meats and fish to either a fire or a range. You'll get better results overall if you use a range, though.
translation: En temel haliyle, Ascilik, cig et ve baliklari atese veya ocaga götürerek yapilabilir. Ancak, ocak kullanirsaniz genel olarak daha iyi sonuclar alirsiniz.

english: Some foods will require you to prepare your ingredients before you can cook them. For example, you first need to mix flour and water into a dough before you can bake them into bread.
translation: Bazi yiyecekleri pisirmeden önce malzemeleri hazirlamaniz gerekir. Örnegin, ekmek pisirmeden önce un ve suyu karistirarak hamur yapmaniz gerekir.

english: As your Cooking level increases, you'll get access to an increasing list of recipes. You'll also find that you accidentally burn your food less of the time as well.
translation: Ascilik seviyeniz arttikca, giderek daha fazla tariflere erisebileceksiniz. Ayrica, yiyeceklerinizi yanlislikla yakma sikliginiz da azalacaktir.

english: Prayer allows you to access different prayers, available from the Prayer side panel. Each prayer offers a different powerful benefit.
translation: Dua, Dua yan panelinden erisebileceginiz farkli dualara erismenizi saglar. Her dua, farkli ve güclü faydalar sunar.

english: Using prayers will drain your prayer points over time. Once you run out of prayer points, you will be unable to use any prayers. You can restore your prayer points by praying at an altar.
translation: Dualari kullanmak zamanla dua puanlarinizi tüketir. Dua puanlariniz bittiginde, hicbir duayi kullanamazsiniz. Bir sunakta dua ederek dua puanlarinizi geri kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Some pieces of equipment will grant you a Prayer bonus, which will reduce the rate at which your prayer points are drained.
translation: Bazi ekipmanlar size Dua bonusu verir ve bu da dua puanlarinizin tükenme hizini azaltir.

english: The most common way to increase your Prayer level is to offer the remains of the enemies you kill. Burying their bones and scattering their ashes will award you Prayer experience.
translation: Dua seviyenizi artirmanin en yaygin yolu, öldürdügünüz düsmanlarin kalintilarini sunmaktir. Kemiklerini gömmek ve küllerini dagitmak size Dua deneyimi kazandirir.

english: Crafting is a wide-ranging skill that allows you to create various pieces of armour, jewellery, equipment and more.
translation: Zanaatkarlik, cesitli zirhlar, mücevherler, ekipmanlar ve daha fazlasini yaratmaniza olanak taniyan genis kapsamli bir beceridir.

english: To craft armour out of animal hides, you'll typically first need to take the hides to a tanner to get them tanned, then combine them with a needle and thread, which can be acquired from certain crafting shops in the world.
translation: Hayvan derilerinden zirh yapmak icin, genellikle önce derileri tabakciya götürerek tabaklamaniz, ardindan bunlari igne ve iplikle birlestirmeniz gerekir. Igne ve iplik, dünyadaki belirli zanaat dükkanlarindan temin edilebilir.

english: To make pottery, you'll need to obtain some soft clay, obtained by adding water to clay. You can then use a pottery wheel to shape the clay into an unfired item, which you can then finish in a pottery oven.
translation: cömlek yapmak icin, kile su ekleyerek elde edilen yumusak kil elde etmeniz gerekir. Daha sonra cömlek carkini kullanarak kili pismemis bir nesneye sekillendirebilir ve ardindan cömlek firininda pisirebilirsiniz.

english: To make jewellery, you'll need to first get a crafting mould. You can then take that mould and some gold or silver bars to a furnace to craft your jewellery. At higher crafting levels, you can cut gems and mould them simultaneously to create jewellery which you can enchant!
translation: Mücevher yapmak icin önce bir zanaat kalibi edinmeniz gerekir. Daha sonra bu kalibi ve bazi altin veya gümüs cubuklari bir firina götürerek mücevherlerinizi yapabilirsiniz. Daha yüksek zanaat seviyelerinde, mücevherleri kesip ayni anda kaliplayarak büyüleyebileceginiz mücevherler yaratabilirsiniz!

english: Firemaking is a skill that allows you to make fires. To do so, simply use a tinderbox on a set of logs and you'll attempt to light them on fire.
translation: Ates yakma, ates yakmanizi saglayan bir beceridir. Bunu yapmak icin, bir odun yiginina bir kibrit kutusu kullanin ve onlari atese vermeye calisin.

english: Higher Firemaking levels will allow you to burn logs that grant more experience, as well as allowing you to burn them quicker.
translation: Daha yüksek ates yakma seviyeleri, daha fazla deneyim kazandiran odunlari daha hizli yakmaniza olanak tanir.

english: Magic grants you access to a wide variety of spells. To cast each spell, you will need a specific set of runes. You can see the runes required by inspecting the spell in either the side panel, or in their tab in this skill guide.
translation: Büyü, cok cesitli büyülere erismenizi saglar. Her büyüyü yapmak icin belirli bir rün setine ihtiyaciniz vardir. Gerekli rünleri, yan panelde veya bu beceri kilavuzundaki sekmede büyüyü inceleyerek görebilirsiniz.

english: You can use certain pieces of equipment to replace runes in order to cast spells. For instance, an equipped staff of air counts as an infinite supply of air runes.
translation: Büyü yapmak icin runelerin yerine belirli ekipman parcalari kullanabilirsiniz. Örnegin, donanmis bir hava asasi, sonsuz hava runesi kaynagi olarak sayilir.

english: Staves can also be used to auto-cast certain offensive spells in combat; to enable this, equip your staff, go to the Combat Options side panel, and select one of the 'Spell' options.
translation: Asalar, savasta belirli saldiri büyülerini otomatik olarak yapmak icin de kullanilabilir; bunu etkinlestirmek icin asanizi donatin, Savas Secenekleri yan paneline gidin ve “Büyü” seceneklerinden birini secin.

english: Fletching allows you to create various ranged weapons, as well as ammunition to go with them.
translation: Ok yapimi, cesitli menzilli silahlar ve bunlara uygun mühimmatlar yaratmaniza olanak tanir.

english: Making bows requires bowstring, which can be made from flax at a spinning wheel. You can use a knife on some logs to carve an unfinished bow, then add the bowstring to complete the weapon.
translation: Yay yapmak icin yay ipi gerekir ve bu ip, egirme carkinda keten kullanilarak yapilabilir. Bazi kütükleri bicakla oyarak bitmemis bir yay yapabilir, ardindan yay ipini ekleyerek silahi tamamlayabilirsiniz.

english: To create arrows, you'll first need to carve logs into arrow shafts with a knife, then tip the arrow shafts with feathers. Finally, you'll need to add some arrow heads.
translation: Ok yapmak icin önce kütükleri bicakla oyarak ok saplari olusturmaniz, ardindan ok saplarinin ucuna tüyler eklemeniz gerekir. Son olarak, ok uclarini eklemeniz gerekir.

english: To make bolts, you only need to combine unfinished bolts with feathers. You can also chisel gemstones down into bolt tips, with each gemstone being able to top a different bolt.
translation: Ok uclari yapmak icin, bitmemis ok uclarini tüylerle birlestirmeniz yeterlidir. Ayrica, her bir degerli tas farkli bir ok ucuna takilabilen degerli taslari oyarak ok uclari yapabilirsiniz.

english: Woodcutting allows you to chop down trees to obtain logs. Most trees in the game can be chopped down with an axe.
translation: Odun kesme, agaclari keserek kütük elde etmenizi saglar. Oyundaki cogu agac balta ile kesilebilir.

english: Increasing your Woodcutting level will give you a higher chance of successfully chopping a tree. You'll also gain access to more trees to cut down.
translation: Odun kesme seviyenizi artirdikca, bir agaci basariyla kesme sansiniz artar. Ayrica, kesebileceginiz daha fazla agaca erisim elde edersiniz.

english: In addition to this, higher Woodcutting levels grant access to more powerful axes, which also increase the chance of chopping trees. Note that you can still use an axe in your inventory if you have the Woodcutting level for it, even if you don't have the Attack level to equip it.
translation: Buna ek olarak, daha yüksek Agac Kesme seviyeleri, agaclari kesme sansini da artiran daha güclü baltalara erisim saglar. Agac Kesme seviyeniz varsa, onu kullanmak icin Saldiri seviyeniz olmasa bile envanterinizdeki baltayi kullanabileceginizi unutmayin.

english: Runecrafting is the skill that allows you to convert essences into runes, which you can use to cast spells.
translation: Rün Yapimi, esanslari büyüler yapmak icin kullanabileceginiz rünlere dönüstürmenizi saglayan beceridir.

english: To create runes, you'll first need some essence and a talisman of the rune you want to make. You can use the talisman to both locate and access the runic altar, which is where the runes are crafted.
translation: Rünler olusturmak icin önce biraz esans ve yapmak istediginiz rünün tilsimina ihtiyaciniz vardir. Tilsimi, rünlerin yapildigi rünik sunaklari bulmak ve onlara erismek icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Higher Runecrafting levels will allow you to craft more kinds of runes. At higher levels, you'll also be able to make multiple runes per essence.
translation: Daha yüksek Rün Yapimi seviyeleri, daha fazla türde rün yapmaniza olanak tanir. Daha yüksek seviyelerde, her esans icin birden fazla rün yapabilirsiniz.

english: Slayer is a skill that lets you fight increasingly dangerous and lucrative monsters. Some monsters can only be fought if you have a high enough Slayer level.
translation: Slayer, giderek daha tehlikeli ve kazancli canavarlarla savasmaniza olanak taniyan bir beceridir. Bazi canavarlarla ancak yeterince yüksek bir Slayer seviyesine sahipseniz savasabilirsiniz.

english: To get started with Slayer, you'll first need a Slayer task, which can be obtained from a Slayer Master. You can then kill the assigned target to get Slayer experience.
translation: Slayer'a baslamak icin önce bir Slayer görevi almaniz gerekir. Bu görevi bir Slayer Ustasi'ndan alabilirsiniz. Ardindan, size verilen hedefi öldürerek Slayer deneyimi kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Once you've completed five tasks, you can start earning reward points, which can be used to skip or block tasks you don't want, or purchase various items and benefits like extended tasks.
translation: Bes görevi tamamladiktan sonra, istemediginiz görevleri atlamak veya engellemek ya da cesitli ögeler ve uzatilmis görevler gibi avantajlar satin almak icin kullanabileceginiz ödül puanlari kazanmaya baslayabilirsiniz.

english: Farming allows you to grow various flowers, vegetables, trees, herbs and more in farming patches across Gielinor.
To get started, you'll need some seeds and a seed dibber, as well as a rake to de-weed the patch you want to use.
translation: Baslamak icin, bazi tohumlar ve bir tohum ekme aleti ile kullanmak istediginiz alani yabani otlardan temizlemek icin bir tirmik gerekir.

english: Once you've cleared the patch, you can add your seed to it. You can also optionally water it with a watering can or add a bucket of compost to decrease the chances of your plant becoming diseased.
translation: Alani temizledikten sonra tohumlarinizi ekebilirsiniz. Istege bagli olarak sulama kabiyla sulayabilir veya bitkinizin hastalanma riskini azaltmak icin bir kova kompost ekleyebilirsiniz.

english: It'll take a while for your plant to grow, so feel free to explore the world and come back to it later!
translation: Bitkinizin büyümesi biraz zaman alacaktir, bu yüzden dünyayi kesfetmek icin zamaninizi ayirin ve daha sonra geri dönün!

english: Once your plant has grown, you might need another tool to collect the harvest. For instance, you'll need a spade to dig up potatoes.
translation: Bitkiniz büyüdükten sonra, hasadi toplamak icin baska bir alete ihtiyaciniz olabilir. Örnegin, patatesleri kazmak icin bir kürek gerekir.

english: If you're worried about your crops becoming diseased, most crops can be protected by the nearby gardeners, but they'll want specific produce in return.
translation: Bitkilerinizin hastalanmasindan endiseleniyorsaniz, cogu bitki yakindaki bahcivanlar tarafindan korunabilir, ancak karsiliginda belirli ürünler isteyeceklerdir.

english: As your Farming level increases, you'll gain access to more crops to grow, as well as obtaining greater yields when harvesting.
translation: ciftcilik seviyeniz arttikca, yetistirebileceginiz daha fazla bitkiye erisim kazanacak ve hasat sirasinda daha fazla verim elde edeceksiniz.

english: Construction gives you access to your very owned Player-Owned House. To get started, you'll need to buy a house from an Estate agent.
translation: Insaat, size kendi oyuncu evinize erisim saglar. Baslamak icin bir emlakcidan ev satin almaniz gerekir.

english: Once you have a house, you'll need to build furniture. Most furniture can be built with planks, which can be obtained via taking logs to a sawmill.
translation: Evinizi aldiktan sonra, mobilya yapmaniz gerekir. cogu mobilya, kereste fabrikasina götürdügünüz kütüklerden elde edebileceginiz tahtalarla yapilabilir.

english: To build furniture, grab a hammer and a saw, enter your house in build mode, select a hotspot and select the furniture you want to build.
translation: Mobilya yapmak icin bir cekic ve testere alin, evinize yapim modunda girin, bir nokta secin ve yapmak istediginiz mobilyayi secin.

english: As your Construction level increases, you'll be able to build bigger houses, gain access to more kinds of room in your house, and be able to build fancier furniture.
translation: Insaat seviyeniz arttikca, daha büyük evler yapabilir, evinizde daha fazla oda türüne erisebilir ve daha süslü mobilyalar yapabilirsiniz.

english: Hunter lets you track and catch a wide variety of wildlife, granting access to various unique materials in the process.
translation: Avci, cok cesitli vahsi hayvanlari takip edip yakalamanizi saglar ve bu sürecte cesitli benzersiz malzemelere erisim imkani sunar.

english: Each animal you can hunt will typically be found in a specfic locale, and will require different gear. Make sure you come prepared!
translation: Avlayabileceginiz her hayvan genellikle belirli bir bölgede bulunur ve farkli ekipmanlar gerektirir. Hazirlikli olun!

english: As your Hunter level improves, not only will you be able to hunt a wider variety of creatures, but you'll also be able to maintain more traps simultaneously, and they will successfully trap creatures more often.
translation: Avci seviyeniz yükseldikce, daha cesitli yaratiklari avlayabileceginiz gibi, ayni anda daha fazla tuzak kurabilir ve bu tuzaklar daha sik basarili olur.

english: Toggle Building mode on and off, allowing construction within your house.
translation: Insaat modunu acip kapatarak evinizin icinde insaat yapmaniza izin verir.

english: Toggle teleport location inside (on) or outside (off) of the house.
translation: Evin icinde (acik) veya disinda (kapali) teleport konumunu degistirir.

english: Toggle Building mode by default when teleport inside the house.
translation: Evin icine teleport edildiginde varsayilan olarak Insaat modunu acar.

english: Render house doors as initially closed.
translation: Ev kapilarini baslangicta kapali olarak görüntüler.

english: Render house doors as initially open.
translation: Ev kapilarini baslangicta acik olarak görüntüler.
